values.note: Primitive riverfront RV sites (RV6-RV10) $28 weeknights, $35 Friday or Saturday; electric/water RV sites (RV1-RV4) $36 weeknights, $45 Friday or Saturday. Base rate includes 4 guests (up to 8); $7.50 per extra guest per night. Booked direct on the operator's site; the old Hipcamp service fee no longer applies.

fees.source: https://www.brooklynheightscamp.com/pricing ('Electric/Water RV Sites are $45/night for a Fri. or Sat. & $36/night weekdays', 'Primitive RV Sites are $35/night for a Fri. or Sat. & $28/night weekdays') + https://book.brooklynheightscamp.com/rv1-electric-rv-site-orp5b7785ax ('Rate - $36-45/night'; site map 'updated September 2026'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://book.brooklynheightscamp.com/rv1-electric-rv-site-orp5b7785ax ('Each site has 30-amp electricity, a 20-amp GFI outlet, and a seasonal water hookup', 'There are no sewer hookups'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Nine RV sites: RV1-RV4 electric/water (RV1's back-in gravel pad takes RVs to 30 ft) and RV6-RV10 primitive riverfront sites across a narrow dead-end road from the river (RV6 back-in, to 35 ft plus tow vehicle); the operator recommends 'RV's 32 to 35 feet or less'. Plus tent, group, cabin, bus and tipi sites.

sites.source: https://book.brooklynheightscamp.com/rv1-electric-rv-site-orp5b7785ax ('accommodates RVs up to 30 feet') + https://book.brooklynheightscamp.com/rv6-primitive-riverfront-rv-site-orp5b7785ex ('Back-in access accommodates a camper up to 35 feet long plus your tow vehicle') + https://www.brooklynheightscamp.com/good-to-know ('RV's 32 to 35 feet or less recommended (plus tow vehicle)'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Portable toilets only. Campground water is untreated and non-potable (seasonal spigots off November 1-April 15); bring drinking water. No operating dump station: off-site dumping at Five Rivers Campground in Parsons, $10 honor system. Wi-Fi near the office cabin and coffee pavilion. Showers and an on-site dump station are planned for 2027.

facilities.source: https://www.brooklynheightscamp.com/good-to-know ('Water is untreated and non-potable; bring drinking water', 'Portable toilets are available at camp', 'No guest showers are available at camp. Showers are planned for 2027', 'Wi-Fi is available near the office cabin and Coffee Pavilion') + https://book.brooklynheightscamp.com/rv1-electric-rv-site-orp5b7785ax ('There are no sewer hookups or operating dump station at the campground. An on-site dump station is planned for 2027'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Open year-round; water is shut off November 1 through April 15.

season.source: https://www.brooklynheightscamp.com/ ('Open year-round') + https://book.brooklynheightscamp.com/rv1-electric-rv-site-orp5b7785ax ('The campground and electricity are available year-round. Water is shut off from November 1 through April 15'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'All sites must be reserved online' on the operator's direct-booking site (OwnerRez); self check-in at the reserved, labeled site. Full refund more than 14 days out, none within 14 days.

booking.source: https://www.brooklynheightscamp.com/rules-cautions ('All sites must be reserved online. Use Book Now Direct') + https://www.brooklynheightscamp.com/good-to-know ('All campsites, cabin sites, and RV sites are self-check in') + https://book.brooklynheightscamp.com/rv1-electric-rv-site-orp5b7785ax (cancellation policy), read 2026-10-21

note: Private campground on the Dry Fork River near Hendricks, about 4 miles from Parsons.  RV sites are basically riverfront but are set back on the other side of a narrow road that likely sees very little traffic. --Claude
summary: Operator site + its OwnerRez booking pages read: base $28 (primitive RV weeknight) to $45 (electric Fri/Sat), 30-amp with seasonal water, no sewer, RVs to 35 ft, open year-round, no showers/dump/potable water (planned 2027), wifi near the office, reserve online only. Note corrected (the river is the Dry Fork, not the Cheat).
